crossRefs.note: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Moab_Plains
people.line: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho

people.name: Nebo_Mount
people.line: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land

translations.web: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
translations.bsb: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
translations.kjv: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
